verdict.line: You lose if you facetank his early Q-auto trades and let Perseverance tick; you win once your Q stun and W-W combo start landing clean around levels 3-5 and your R disables his turret for dives.

brief.thesis: This lane is a sustain war disguised as a brawl: Garen's Perseverance heals him back whenever he goes a few seconds untouched, so the whole matchup hinges on whether you keep Sky Splitter (E) on cooldown rotation to deny that regen while your own Frenzied Maul (W) mark-and-detonate heals you back in kind. At 49.6% over 2269 games this is a lane you're built to win on repeated trades and tower-disabling dives, not on a single all-in.

theirWindow.what: He'll stand and spin Judgment (E) freely because he's healing through it. Don't match him auto-for-auto in that window - reset the trade with a Sky Splitter poke to shut the regen off before committing again.

yourWindow.what: Decisive Strike is only up every 8 seconds and is his one tool to break your slows and silence you mid-combo. Once it's down, Thundering Smash (Q) him for the stun and run the full W-auto-W mark-detonate-heal without fear of being cut off.

powerCurve.note: Q stun plus W-W sustain wins trades

start.why: Runs a 53.4% win rate over 517 games, and the raw AD and sustain fit how Frenzied Maul's on-hit mark-and-heal actually scales - Volibear has no use for Doran's Ring's mana regen when the whole trade pattern is auto-attack based.

boots.why: The standard pick at 54.5% pick rate; flattens the steady physical chip from Garen's autos and Judgment spins that otherwise add up across every extended trade.

core.why: On-hit attack speed and damage directly amplifies the passive's bonus magic damage proc and every Frenzied Maul mark you apply.
Cooldown refund on takedowns keeps Thundering Smash and Sky Splitter cycling faster, letting you re-engage and re-poke his passive more often in a single fight.
Heal and shield power amplifies both the Frenzied Maul recast heal and Stormbringer's bonus health, turning every trade you win into a bigger sustain lead.

situational.when: they build crit items or extra AD threats show up on their team
the game goes long and you need more raw sustained damage
the lane turns into a prolonged poke war instead of short trades

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed over the duration of a fight compounds with the passive's own on-hit attack speed stacking, so every extended W-auto-W trade gets faster and hits harder the longer it goes - exactly the fight Garen's passive is trying to outlast.

summoners.why: The 74.8% pick rate combo for a reason: Ignite's damage-over-time punishes Garen for standing in Perseverance's heal window by cutting into the exact health he's trying to regen, while Flash extends your Q stun range for a clean engage or a safe exit.

playing.title: Open with E, not Q
playing.detail: Sky Splitter's 1200 range lets you chip Garen before he can step into his level-1 Q-auto trade, and it keeps his Perseverance from ever starting its tick.

playing.title: Deny Perseverance constantly
playing.detail: Any few seconds untouched and Garen starts healing back. Rotate E or an auto onto him on cooldown so he's always 'recently damaged' and the regen never fires.

playing.title: Hold Q until his Q is down
playing.detail: Decisive Strike's 8s cooldown is his only way to silence you or break your slows mid-combo. Once it's used, Thundering Smash him for the stun and run your full combo risk-free.

playing.title: W-auto-W every single trade
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul's 5s cooldown means you can mark and detonate in nearly every exchange; the second cast's heal directly cancels out his own sustain.

playing.title: Use R to disable the turret and dive
playing.detail: Stormbringer's landing temporarily disables nearby towers, letting you force dives starting level 6 that he can't punish with a tower shot.

playing.title: Respect his shrinking E cooldown
playing.detail: Judgment drops from 13s to 9s by max rank, so by levels 9-13 he can spin far more often - don't facetank extended trades without your W-heal timed to answer it.

playing.title: Play around his R past level 6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice falls to a 20s cooldown at rank 5 around levels 16-18 and threatens an execute - don't sit low in his walk-up range after a trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1); the matchup reading - the Perseverance-denial pattern, the trade windows around his Q, and the skill-order reasoning - is my own tactical judgment layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] often to prevent Garen’s (P) from activating. Use Grasp of the Undying whenever it comes off cooldown to engage combat.
